Interface Researcher

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ResearcherDecorator, ResearcherEmployee, Student, Teacher
public interface Researcher extends Serializable
Anyone capable of doing research. Implemented directly by ResearcherEmployee and ResearcherDecorator; also by Teacher and Student (gated on isResearcher()).
